demo_extraction.scope_summary: Develop a municipal services web portal for water, sanitation and property tax. Provide on-site support at the Board's offices. Train municipal staff and maintain the portal for one year.

eligibility.requirement: Valid NTN and active ATL status
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must hold a valid National Tax Number (NTN) and appear on the FBR Active Taxpayers List (ATL).

eligibility.requirement: Minimum annual turnover of PKR 15 million in the last financial year.
eligibility.source_quote: Minimum annual turnover of PKR 15 million in the last financial year.
The bidder must have a registered head office in Karachi at the time of bid submission. Bids from firms without a Karachi office shall be rejected.
Affidavit on stamp paper that the bidder has not been blacklisted by any government body.
Bid security in the form of a pay order or bank guarantee shall accompany the financial bid.
